acceptanceCriteria: A file with two tests mounting different components attributes each mount to its own test only.
An if/else shell assignment is reported as unknown (or both values) instead of the last assignment.
A route registration followed by unrelated code does not absorb that code's fields.
body: Failure modes recorded (not fixed) by the V1-1939/1940 lane (PR #1205): (1) mounts are collected per file, not per test, so a mount in one test is credited to its siblings; (2) shell scripts are read last-assignment-wins, so branch-dependent assignments get the wrong derivation; (3) stand-in route fields run to the next registration rather than being bounded by the handler body.
title: Env contract precision: per-test mounts, ordered shell evaluation, handler-bounded route fields
